summary: This directory defines the TypeScript schemas for representing and analyzing JSDoc documentation, including raw content, parsed structural components, protected code regions, and metadata regarding human edits and generation history.
responsibilities: Defining structural schemas for parsed JSDoc comments
Modeling protected code regions for preservation
Capturing metadata about JSDoc generation and human modifications
Providing analytical metrics for documentation quality
relationships: ParsedJsDoc structures integrate individual tags like JsDocParam, JsDocReturns, and JsDocThrows.
RawJsDoc serves as the source material for generating a ParsedJsDoc representation.
JsDocAnalysis aggregates metrics about documentation quality, including references to HumanEditSignal.
ProtectedRegion and ProtectedSection define how parts of documentation are isolated and safeguarded during generation processes.
designDecisions: Schema-first definition using const objects to provide both runtime validation and static TypeScript types.
Explicit separation between raw documentation content and parsed structural components.
Modular grouping of schema definitions by JSDoc concern.
